subject: Sorry for the mix-up at the weekend
text: I want to clear up the mix-up from Saturday because I think I gave an unclear instruction, and that caused more work than it should have. When I mentioned meeting near the park, I meant the side by the library, not the main entrance, and I should have written it plainly the first time. I know several of you turned up early, waited around, and then had to rearrange plans while I was still looking for signs. That was not fair, and I am sorry for the stress it added to an otherwise simple get-together. I also appreciate that no one was angry in the moment, but I still feel responsible for the confusion. The weather made it worse, and I realize that standing by the wrong gate with bags and folding chairs was not anyone's ideal start to the afternoon. For future plans, I will send the exact address and a short landmark note, and I will check that the message has reached everyone before I change details. If it helps, I will cover the extra parking tickets or transport fees that came from arriving at the wrong location. Please tell me if I have missed anyone. I value having this little group, and I would rather over-explain than create another avoidable hassle. Once again, my apologies for the unclear wording and the inconvenience it caused. I hope we can all move past this without it lingering, because my intention was only to save us a few steps, not to turn a small outing into a scavenger hunt.
